info.name: Learning to Speak the Kitty Language
info.parent: Sakura, the Kitty, and the Orange Marble

descriptions.notStarted: Where's the #bBoss Kitty#k that stole Orange Marble?
descriptions.inProgress: I went up to the #bBoss Kitty#k and asked something, only to hear some language I've never even heard of in my life. I better ask #bScarred Kitty#k for some kitty language, then I may be able to pick up on it.
descriptions.completed: I learned the kitty language through #bThe Scarred Kitty#k! Now I can probably communicate with #bBoss Kitty#k.
